scope: Native Canvas HUD occlusion geometry and world/screen conversion; no runtime or asset changes

hudCssRects.safeBottomMeaning: wx safeArea absolute y, not an inset

worldScreenTransform.dprRule: CSS HUD rectangles are not multiplied by dpr

knownGap: Renderer _damageRectInView() only checks world _view; production NativeGame overlays HUD after renderer.showHud=false, so labels can be hidden by top/bottom HUD.
requiredBoundaryCases: safe top/bottom absent, zero, negative and out-of-range
label box exactly at top+134 or bottom start and boxes crossing those edges
camera/zoom changes with inverse world conversion
upgrade/paused/won/lost modal overlays suppress or explicitly cover feedback
nextSafeStep: First normalize safe insets and add a renderer HUD-avoidance helper with deterministic Node boundary tests; do not claim global occlusion or web/native parity until real Edge evidence is rerun.
